exposure: family perception, awareness and knowledge about CS
cohort: 249 post-caesarean section mothers and their family members in India participated in the study.
finding: The study found that participants with annual incomes between 3 to 6 lakhs INR experienced less hospital cost burden, and partial insurance coverage made the financial burden bearable, consuming 20-30% of savings.
mod_finding: The study revealed that caesarean sections impose financial burdens on families, which were mitigated by specific income brackets or partial insurance coverage.
cross-section timing: Third post-operative day after caesarean section
